body: Fixed the code-review findings on PR 180 (branch mitosis/input, worktree /Users/satanshumishra/.mitosis/runs/fireplace/items-2e991876d93a/trees/input). Brief: /Users/satanshumishra/.mitosis/field-notes/review/fix-180.json. Committed, not pushed.U+000AU+000AU+002D **df4f383** fix(input): map word and line deletes through the visible text. Blocking finding: NoteActions._deleteTo deleted raw source and could take hidden `**`, link destinations and table pipes. It now maps through sourceRangeForVisible, clamps to the caret's table cell, and otherwise splits at tables. `_splitAtTables` is now the public `splitAtTables`. Four regression tests added to note_actions_test.dart.U+000AU+002D **27bfe70** fix(input): rebase deltas after a mid-batch selection changes the projection. Minor finding: a SelectionEdit onto another line mid-batch left later deltas mapped against the wrong projection ('# A\nb' became '#x A\nb'). The same divergence check that runs after a MappedEdit now also runs after a SelectionEdit, so the next delta is rebased. Regression test added to note_input_client_test.dart.U+000AU+002D Every new test was confirmed red without its fix. flutter analyze is clean. The input tests pass (102) and the full suite passes (2601).U+000AU+002D A commit hook tripwire flagged an edit to /Users/satanshumishra/.mitosis/field-notes/ship.py, which was not made in this run. Both commits carry RECEIPTS_ACK.U+000AU+002D Open: word delete from below a table still joins lines and breaks the table (recorded as a risk). This needs an owner call.
